description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Olaf''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed for 5 seconds.
description.text: Active: Olaf gains  bonus attack speed for 5 seconds.

description2.raw: He also grants himself a [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shield]] for 2.5 seconds for an amount that is capped at 70% '''missing''' health.
description2.text: He also grants himself a shield for 2.5 seconds for an amount that is capped at 70% missing health.

description3.raw: ''Tough It Out [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Olaf's''' basic attack timer.''
description3.text: Tough It Out resets Olaf's basic attack timer.

leveling2.raw:
'''Shield Strength:'''
10 / 40 / 70 / 100 / 130 (+ 17.5% '''missing''' health)

notes.raw: * ''Tough It Out's'' '''bonus''' attack speed value is updated when it is cast, even if it was already active. * At 70% '''missing''' health, the health ratio portion of the shield is capped at the equivalent of 12.5% '''maximum''' health.
notes.text:
Tough It Out's bonus attack speed value is updated when it is cast, even if it was already active.
At 70% missing health, the health ratio portion of the shield is capped at the equivalent of 12.5% maximum health.
